# wordpress — 2021 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=9, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 1355 wordpress CVEs of 2021 are in `data/cve/vendors/wordpress/2021.jsonl`.

### CVE-2021-3120
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2021-02-22 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AC:L/AV:N/A:H/C:H/I:H/PR:N/S:U/UI:N`

An arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards Premium plugin before 3.3.1 for WordPress allows remote attackers to achieve remote code execution on the operating system in the security context of the web server. In order to exploit this vulnerability, an attacker must be able to place a valid Gift Card product into the shopping cart. An uploaded file is placed at a predetermined path on the web server with a user-specified filename and extension. This occurs because the ywgc-upload-picture parameter can have a .php value even though the intention was to only allow uploads of Gift Card images.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://yithemes.com/themes/plugins/yith-woocommerce-gift-cards/ [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/guy-liu/yith-giftdrop [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2021-4073 — RegistrationMagic <= 5.0.1.7 Authentication Bypass
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2021-12-14 | Updated: 2025-02-14 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The RegistrationMagic WordPress plugin made it possible for unauthenticated users to log in as any site user, including administrators, if they knew a valid username on the site due to missing identity validation in the social login function social_login_using_email() of the plugin. This affects versions equal to, and less than, 5.0.1.7.

**solutions:** Update to version 5.0.1.8, or newer.

Affected:
- RegistrationMagic / RegistrationMagic: affected 5.0.1.7 <=5.0.1.7 (custom)

Credits: Chloe Chamberland, Wordfence; Marco Wotschka, Wordfence; AyeCode Ltd

References:
- https://www.wordfence.com/vulnerability-advisories/#CVE-2021-4073 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/changeset/2635173/custom-registration-form-builder-with-submission-manager/trunk/services/class_rm_user_services.php [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.wordfence.com/blog/2021/12/authentication-bypass-vulnerability-patched-in-user-registration-plugin/ [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2021-4340 — uListing <= 1.6.6 - Unauthenticated SQL Injection
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2023-06-07 | Updated: 2026-04-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-89 CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The uListing plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the ‘listing_id’ parameter in versions up to, and including, 1.6.6 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query.  This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

Affected:
- stylemix / Directory Listings WordPress plugin – uListing: affected 0 <1.7 (semver)

Credits: Jerome Bruandet

References:
- https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/10b7a88f-ce46-42aa-ab5a-81f38288a659?source=cve

### CVE-2021-24299 — ReDi Restaurant Reservations < 21.0426 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)

- Exploit-DB 49903: WordPress Plugin ReDi Restaurant Reservation 21.0307 - 'Comment' Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) (webapps/php, 2021-05-24, verified=0)

The ReDi Restaurant Reservation WordPress plugin before 21.0426 provides the functionality to let users make restaurant reservations. These reservations are stored and can be listed on an 'Upcoming' page provided by the plugin. An unauthenticated user can fill in the form to make a restaurant reservation. The form to make a restaurant reservation field called 'Comment' does not use proper input validation and can be used to store XSS payloads. The XSS payloads will be executed when the plugin user goes to the 'Upcoming' page, which is an external website https://upcoming.reservationdiary.eu/ loaded in an iframe, and the stored reservation with XSS payload is loaded.

Affected:
- Reservation Diary / ReDi Restaurant Reservation: affected 21.0426 <21.0426 (custom)

Credits: Bastijn Ouwendijk

References:
- https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/fd6ce00b-8c5f-4180-b648-f47b37303670 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2021-24964 — LiteSpeed Cache < 4.4.4 - IP Check Bypass to Unauthenticated Stored XSS

- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 6.1 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

The LiteSpeed Cache WordPress plugin before 4.4.4 does not properly verify that requests are coming from QUIC.cloud servers, allowing attackers to make requests to certain endpoints by using a specific X-Forwarded-For header value. In addition, one of the endpoint could be used to set CSS code if a setting is enabled, which will then be output in some pages without being sanitised and escaped. Combining those two issues, an unauthenticated attacker could put Cross-Site Scripting payloads in pages visited by users.

Affected:
- Unknown / LiteSpeed Cache: affected 4.4.4 <4.4.4 (custom)

### CVE-2021-29447 — WordPress Authenticated XXE attack when installation is running PHP 8
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2021-04-15 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 7.1
- CWE: CWE-611 {"CWE-611":"Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference"}
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N`
- Exploit-DB 50304: WordPress 5.7 - 'Media Library' XML External Entity Injection (XXE) (Authenticated) (webapps/php, 2021-09-20, verified=0)

Wordpress is an open source CMS. A user with the ability to upload files (like an Author) can exploit an XML parsing issue in the Media Library leading to XXE attacks. This requires WordPress installation to be using PHP 8. Access to internal files is possible in a successful XXE attack. This has been patched in WordPress version 5.7.1, along with the older affected versions via a minor release. We strongly recommend you keep auto-updates enabled.

Affected:
- WordPress / wordpress-develop: affected >= 5.6.0, < 5.7.1

### CVE-2021-34646 — Booster for WooCommerce <= 5.4.3 Authentication Bypass
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2021-08-30 | Updated: 2025-05-05 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-290 CWE-290 Authentication Bypass by Spoofing
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- Exploit-DB 50299: WordPress Plugin WooCommerce Booster Plugin 5.4.3 - Authentication Bypass (webapps/php, 2021-09-17, verified=0)

Versions up to, and including, 5.4.3, of the Booster for WooCommerce WordPress plugin are vulnerable to authentication bypass via the process_email_verification function due to a random token generation weakness in the reset_and_mail_activation_link function found in the ~/includes/class-wcj-emails-verification.php file. This allows attackers to impersonate users and trigger an email address verification for arbitrary accounts, including administrative accounts, and automatically be logged in as that user, including any site administrators. This requires the Email Verification module to be active in the plugin and the Login User After Successful Verification setting to be enabled, which it is by default.

**solutions:** Update to version 5.4.4 or newer.

Affected:
- Pluggabl LLC / Booster for WooCommcerce: affected 5.4.3 <=5.4.3 (custom)

Credits: Chloe Chamberland, Wordfence

References:
- https://www.wordfence.com/blog/2021/08/critical-authentication-bypass-vulnerability-patched-in-booster-for-woocommerce/ [x_refsource_MISC]
